L18·N653unmasked layer
This neuron fires at the point where a second, contrasting member of a parallel/repeated construction begins (e.g. "Third Party…(First Party", "work by X…work by Y", "no Europe or no Europe", "lower sub…upper sub", "shaft type…shaftless type"), i.e. on the token introducing the repeated-but-contrasted item; it is suppressed on similar tokens when no such contrastive repetition follows.
